beatbox.bridge.title: The bridge
beatbox.bridge.down: No answer from BeatBox. This page only works inside its window.
beatbox.probe.kvm.ready: /dev/kvm is present and this user can open it
beatbox.probe.kvm.missing: No /dev/kvm, so machines run much slower. Turn on virtualization in the firmware, or load the kvm module.
beatbox.probe.kvm.not_linux: KVM is Linux-only. A guest still runs here, just without hardware acceleration.
beatbox.probe.qemu.missing: qemu-system-x86_64 was not found, so no machine can start. Install QEMU, or point BEATBOX_QEMU_DIR at one.
beatbox.probe.frida.ready: frida {version} — the guest still needs frida-server in its own image
beatbox.probe.frida.missing: frida was not found; it comes with frida-tools
beatbox.probe.terminal.no_pty: a real terminal needs a pty, and pty is POSIX-only
beatbox.engine.unknown_type: There is no sandbox type called {type} in this build.
beatbox.engine.bad_transition: “{transition}” is not possible while it is “{state}”.
beatbox.engine.bad_argument: The request “{capability}” came with {argument} in the wrong form (it should be {kind}).
beatbox.engine.peer_missing: This sandbox needs a {role}, and none was named.
beatbox.engine.peer_unknown: There is no sandbox called {target} to be its {role}, or more than one.
beatbox.engine.peer_lacks: {peer} cannot be used as its {role}: it cannot do “{capability}”.
beatbox.engine.peer_unexpected: This kind of sandbox has no {role} to fill.
beatbox.engine.peer_undeclared: This never said it would ask its {role} for “{capability}”.
beatbox.engine.peer_gone: The sandbox that was its {role} is gone.
beatbox.engine.peer_self: A sandbox cannot be its own {role}.
beatbox.engine.peer_cycle: {peer} already uses this one, so it cannot be its {role}.
beatbox.engine.peer_absent: This sandbox has no {role}: none was named when it was made.
beatbox.engine.peer_fixed: Which sandboxes this one uses is fixed when it is made.
beatbox.engine.isolation_too_weak: A {type} sandbox isolates at the {provided} level, and this one asked for {required}. BeatBox never hands back a weaker boundary than the one that was asked for.
beatbox.engine.over_budget: Not enough {resource} left: {requested} asked for, {available} free.
beatbox.engine.cannot_act: While it is “{state}”, nothing can be asked of it.
beatbox.engine.not_running: This is off, so it cannot do that yet. Turn it on first.
beatbox.engine.provider_failed: Something went wrong inside BeatBox while trying to “{step}” ({type}). It is a BeatBox bug, not something you did. Detail: {detail}
beatbox.engine.sandbox_lost: This {type} stopped answering, and what was inside it is gone.
beatbox.engine.no_such_file: That file does not exist on the machine: {path}
beatbox.engine.no_such_snapshot: There is no save point called {name}.
beatbox.engine.mock_refused: The mock sandbox was told to refuse {step}, and did.
beatbox.argument.name: name
beatbox.screen.engine.title: Engine
beatbox.screen.engine.blurb: The sandbox runtime with its own vocabulary on the screen: lifecycle transitions by name, capabilities as the identifiers they are declared by, facts as the provider reports them, and every event in the order the bus stamped it. A debugger, not the product — the Sandbox screen is that.
beatbox.engine.reconfigure_not_now: Settings can only change while it is off; right now it is “{state}”.
beatbox.engine.reconfigure_type: A reconfiguration cannot change what kind of sandbox this is ({type}).
beatbox.probe.kvm.no_permission: You cannot open /dev/kvm, so machines run about ten times slower. Run sudo usermod -aG kvm $USER, then log out and back in.
beatbox.probe.kvm.whpx_ready: the Windows Hypervisor Platform is on, so guests run on Windows' own hypervisor
beatbox.probe.kvm.whpx_missing: the Windows Hypervisor Platform is off, so machines run about ten times slower. Turn it on in “Turn Windows features on or off” and restart.
beatbox.daemon.unreachable: BeatBox's engine is not answering ({detail}). Close BeatBox and open it again.
beatbox.daemon.wrong_contract: The window and the engine are different versions (window {theirs}, engine {ours}). Close BeatBox and open it again.

beatbox.vocab.event.sandbox.reset: It was put back as it was made
beatbox.vocab.field.name: The name
beatbox.say.unknown: Something went wrong. Close BeatBox and open it again; if it keeps happening, the engine's log has the details.
beatbox.say.detail.refused: nothing was listening on the other side
beatbox.say.detail.port_busy: the port is already taken by another program
beatbox.say.detail.read_only: that place can only be read, not written
beatbox.say.detail.not_found: the file or folder does not exist
beatbox.say.detail.unreachable: there is no way to it on the network
beatbox.say.detail.timeout: it did not answer in time
beatbox.say.detail.busy: it is in use by something else
beatbox.api.bad-archive: There is no disk inside this file to take out.
beatbox.api.bad-disk: This disk cannot be made with those settings.
beatbox.api.bad-name: A disk name is just a name, without folders or slashes.
beatbox.api.bad-payload: BeatBox did not understand its own request. That is a bug, not something you did.
beatbox.api.bad-step: That setup step does not exist.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-dependent: This disk is part of a set that needs other disks too, so it cannot be copied alone.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-leave-out: That is not something on this disk that can be left out.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-mounted: This disk is in use by the system right now. Start the computer from another system to copy it.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-partial: A copy with this name was left unfinished. Remove it or choose another name.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-platform: Copying physical disks works on Linux only, for now.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-size: The size of this disk could not be read.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-source: Choose a physical disk from the list.
beatbox.api.beatdrop-target: Choose where to keep the copy.
beatbox.api.busy: Something like this is already running. Wait for it to finish.
beatbox.api.disk-exists: There is already a disk with that name. Choose another.
beatbox.api.disk-in-use: A machine is still using this disk. Delete that machine first.
beatbox.api.no-sandbox: That no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
beatbox.api.not-fixable: BeatBox cannot set this up from here. Follow the instructions shown for it.
beatbox.api.transport: This page only works inside the BeatBox window.
